shots.name: Hook
shots.action: Huge type snaps upward on beats. An orange slash grows into the persistent hero surface.
shots.goal: Create curiosity about making an idea move.
shots.focalPoint: Large headline, then the orange slash.
shots.transition: The slash widens into the code panel.

shots.name: Code
shots.action: The slash opens into a dark code panel; a readable timeline call enters line by line.
shots.goal: Connect editable code with the animation that follows.
shots.transition: The panel keeps its position as code dissolves into motion.

shots.name: Motion
shots.action: Code becomes an orange motion study: nested panels rotate, slide and settle around a bold monogram.
shots.goal: Show the visual payoff from code.
shots.transition: The same surface shrinks into a review frame.
shots.sound: Percussion opens up with a motion accent.

shots.name: Review
shots.action: The surface joins two graphic frames in a contact-sheet arrangement. A selected frame changes composition.
shots.goal: Show that iteration changes the composition.
shots.focalPoint: Selected orange frame among two alternatives.
shots.transition: Other cards leave; the selected frame becomes a tall export.
shots.sound: Short rhythmic notes support the variations.

shots.name: Formats
shots.action: The same visual becomes a tall frame and a wide frame; their layouts settle on the beat.
shots.goal: Show that one idea can be recomposed for two formats.
shots.focalPoint: Tall orange output and wide cream output.
shots.transition: An orange wipe carries the identity into the ending.

shots.name: Brand
shots.action: An orange wipe fills the frame, the motif lands in the identity, and the headline resolves to a stable closing shot.
shots.goal: Leave a memorable name and invitation to create.
shots.transition: Hold the resolved wordmark through the final frame.
shots.sound: Final chord with a clean decay.
